resources.string: Works with the music apps you already use. Turn it off and their sound is left as it was.
These settings make the sound louder in your ears. Your listening budget does not count this extra, so go easy on the volume.
Another equaliser app took over the effects of %1$s. Close it or turn off its effects to use these.
Another equaliser app took over the effects of all the phone’s audio. Close it or turn off its effects to use these.
Your profile “%1$s” has its own curve, from the hearing check. While that profile is active, it is used instead of this one.
Raises quiet songs. A limiter keeps the loud parts from distorting.
The most reliable. Works with apps that announce their audio, and with every app once full detection is on.
For when your music app is not detected. Not every phone applies it: if you hear no change, go back to “Each music app”.
No music app detected yet. Play something.
Applied to all the phone’s audio.
Full detection is on: every music app gets the effects.
Some apps, such as YouTube Music, do not announce their audio. To reach them too, connect the phone to a computer with USB debugging on and run this once:
It only lets WaveHeaven see which apps are playing, never what they play. It goes away if you uninstall the app.
